blocks.text: 13-darsda Present Perfect va Past Simple ni **natija** nuqtai nazaridan solishtirdik (→ 13-dars). Bu darsda ikkinchi muhim mezon — gapdagi **vaqt so'zi**. Agar u o'tmishda **tugagan** vaqtni bildirsa (yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2015, when I was a child) — faqat Past Simple. Agar u hozirni ham o'z ichiga olgan, hali **tugamagan** davr bo'lsa (today, this week, this year, so far, recently) — Present Perfect. O'zbek tilida bu farq yo'q: «**Bugun** uch piyola choy ichdim» va «**Kecha** uch piyola choy ichdim» — ikkalasi ham «-dim». Inglizchada: I**'ve drunk** three cups today / I **drank** three cups yesterday. Asoslari: → qizil kitob, 20-dars.

rows: last week / last month / last year
this week / this month / this year
in 2015, in the nineties, on Monday
**so far**, **up to now**, **in the last** ten years
**when** I was a child, during the war

items.text: I **drank** too much coffee **yesterday** and couldn't sleep.
items.translation: **Kecha** juda ko'p qahva **ichdim** va uxlay olmadim.

items.text: I**'ve drunk** too much coffee **today**, and my hands are shaking.

blocks.text: this morning, today, this week — davr tugaganmi?

**this morning**, **this afternoon** kabi so'zlarda zamon gapirilayotgan vaqtga bog'liq. Soat o'nda «ertalab» hali davom etyapti — Present Perfect: I **haven't had** breakfast this morning. Soat uchda ertalab tugagan — Past Simple: I **didn't have** breakfast this morning. **today**, **this week**, **this year** odatda hali tugamagan, shuning uchun Present Perfect bilan keladi. Lekin bugungi kunning **aniq bir paytidagi** tugagan voqeani aytsak, Past Simple ham to'g'ri: I **saw** Aziz at the bazaar today (ertalab, bozorda — o'sha payt o'tib ketgan).

rows: I**'ve been** late twice this week.
We **had** a lot of rain in the spring.

items.text: It's eleven o'clock, and Tom **hasn't phoned** this morning.
items.translation: Soat o'n bir, Tom esa **bugun ertalab qo'ng'iroq qilmadi**.

items.text: It's evening now. Tom **didn't phone** this morning, so I called him.
items.translation: Hozir kechqurun. Tom **bugun ertalab qo'ng'iroq qilmadi**, shuning uchun o'zim qildim.

blocks.text: recently, so far, ever, yet — «hozirgacha» so'zlari

**recently** / **lately** (so'nggi paytlarda), **so far** / **up to now** (hozircha), **ever** / **never** (umrim bo'yi), **yet** (hali), **in the last** few days (so'nggi bir necha kunda) — barchasi hozirgacha cho'zilgan davrni bildiradi, shuning uchun Present Perfect bilan keladi: **So far** we**'ve sold** 300 tickets. Diqqat: **just** (hozirgina) Present Perfect bilan, **just now** (bir lahza oldin) esa Past Simple bilan: I**'ve just seen** him = I **saw** him **just now**.

items.text: **So far** nobody **has complained** about the new timetable.
Madina **phoned just now** — she'll be late.

blocks.text: for va when: davr ochiqmi, yopiqmi?

**for** o'zi zamonni hal qilmaydi — muhimi, davr hozirgacha davom etyaptimi. I**'ve lived** in London **for five years** — hali ham Londonda yashayman; I **lived** in London **for five years** — endi u yerda emasman. **When ...?** savoli va **when I was ...** kabi ergash gaplar doim o'tmishdagi nuqta yoki tugagan davrni bildiradi, shuning uchun Past Simple: **When did** you **move**? («When have you moved?» emas). **Have you ever ...?** — hayotingiz hali davom etyapti; **Did you ever ...?** — tugagan davr haqida: Did your grandfather ever travel abroad?

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I've seen him yesterday» → I **saw** him yesterday; «When have you arrived?» → **When did** you arrive?; «I've finished school in 2018» → I **finished** school in 2018; «I've lived in Samarkand for three years, now I live in Tashkent» → I **lived** (davr tugagan); kechqurun «This morning I've been to the bank» → I **went** to the bank this morning; «two days before» → two days **ago** (hozirdan hisoblaganda).

Gapdagi vaqt so'zini toping va uni ikki qutidan biriga soling: «**yopiq quti**» (yesterday, ago, last ..., in 2015, when ...) — Past Simple; «**ochiq quti**» (today, this ..., so far, ever, yet, recently, since ...) — Present Perfect. Vaqt so'zi bo'lmasa — 13-darsdagi «hozir-chi?» testi.

Amerika ingliz tilida «Did you see him recently?», «Did you eat yet?» ham ishlatiladi. Britaniya ingliz tilida **recently**, **yet**, **already**, **ever** bilan odatda Present Perfect: **Have** you **eaten** yet?

rows: this morning (hali ertalab / endi tushdan keyin)
I **haven't seen** him this morning. / I **didn't see** him this morning.
I**'ve just seen** him. / I **saw** him **just now**.

examples.title: Finished time: **yesterday**, **ago**, **in 2018**
examples.description: Aniq tugagan vaqt — yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2018, on Monday — bilan faqat Past Simple. Bu vaqt hozirni o'z ichiga olmaydi.

sentences.text: I **sent** you the documents **yesterday afternoon** — check your spam folder.
sentences.translation: Hujjatlarni sizga **kecha tushdan keyin yubordim** — spam papkasini tekshiring.

sentences.text: Tom **started** his new job **two weeks ago**, and he's already very happy there.
sentences.translation: Tom yangi ishini **ikki hafta oldin boshladi** va u yerda allaqachon juda mamnun.

sentences.text: **Last summer** we **rented** a little house near Lake Charvak.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan yozda** Chorvoq ko'li yaqinidan kichik uy **ijaraga oldik**.

sentences.text: Madina **graduated** from university **in 2018** and **moved** to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Madina universitetni **2018-yilda bitirdi** va Buxoroga **ko'chdi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **watch** the debate on TV **last night**?
sentences.translation: **Kecha kechqurun** televizorda debatni **ko'rdingizmi**?

sentences.text: The shop **closed down** **a few months ago** because of the high rent.
sentences.translation: Do'kon ijara haqi balandligi tufayli **bir necha oy oldin yopildi**.

sentences.text: We **didn't go** anywhere **last weekend** because Jasur **was** ill.
sentences.translation: Jasur kasal **bo'lgani** uchun **o'tgan dam olish kunlari** hech qayerga **bormadik**.

sentences.text: **On Monday** my laptop suddenly **stopped** working in the middle of a meeting.
sentences.translation: **Dushanba kuni** noutbukim majlis o'rtasida birdan **ishlamay qoldi**.

sentences.text: When **did** your parents **buy** this flat? — **In the nineties**, I think.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz bu kvartirani **qachon sotib olishgan**? — Menimcha, **to'qsoninchi yillarda**.

sentences.text: **The day before yesterday** Emma **ran** her first half-marathon in Oxford.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan kuni** Emma Oksfordda birinchi yarim marafonini **yugurdi**.

examples.title: Unfinished period: **today**, **this week**, **this year**
examples.description: Hozirni o'z ichiga olgan, hali tugamagan davr — today, this week, this month, this year — bilan Present Perfect: davr davom etyapti, natija hali o'zgarishi mumkin.

sentences.text: I**'ve drunk** four cups of tea **today**, and it's only eleven o'clock.
sentences.translation: **Bugun** to'rt piyola choy **ichdim**, soat esa hali o'n bir.

sentences.text: Aziz **has been** late for work twice **this week**.
sentences.translation: Aziz **bu hafta** ishga ikki marta **kechikdi**.

sentences.text: **This year** the company **has hired** fifty new engineers.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya **bu yil** ellikta yangi muhandisni **ishga oldi**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **done** any exercise **this week**, or have you been too busy?
sentences.translation: **Bu hafta** biror mashq **qildingizmi** yoki juda band bo'ldingizmi?

sentences.text: It **hasn't rained** in Tashkent **this month**, and the parks look very dry.
sentences.translation: **Bu oy** Toshkentda yomg'ir **yog'madi**, bog'lar juda qaqrab qolgan.

sentences.text: Kate **has read** three books **this month** — she reads on the train every day.
sentences.translation: Keyt **bu oy** uchta kitob **o'qidi** — u har kuni poyezdda o'qiydi.

sentences.text: We**'ve had** a lot of problems with the heating **this winter**.
sentences.translation: **Bu qish** isitish tizimi bilan ko'p **muammo bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: How many emails **have** you **answered** **today**? — Only a few, unfortunately.
sentences.translation: **Bugun** nechta xatga **javob berdingiz**? — Afsuski, bir nechtasiga.

sentences.text: Prices in the shops **have** already **gone up** twice **this year**.
sentences.translation: **Bu yil** do'konlarda narxlar allaqachon ikki marta **ko'tarildi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **hasn't called** his mother **today**, so she's starting to worry.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **bugun** onasiga **qo'ng'iroq qilmadi**, shuning uchun u xavotirlana boshladi.

examples.title: Open or closed: **today** / **yesterday**, **this** / **last**
examples.description: Bir gapda ikki davr: tugamagan davr — Present Perfect, tugagan davr — Past Simple. Farqni vaqt so'zi hal qiladi.

sentences.text: I **haven't seen** Sarah **today**, but I **saw** her **yesterday** at the gym.
sentences.translation: Sarani **bugun ko'rmadim**, lekin **kecha** sport zalida **ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: **This year** our village **has had** very little snow, but **last year** we **had** plenty.
sentences.translation: **Bu yil** qishlog'imizga juda kam qor **yog'di**, **o'tgan yili** esa mo'l **yoqqan**.

sentences.text: Jasur **has scored** five goals **this season**; **last season** he **scored** only two.
sentences.translation: Jasur **bu mavsumda** beshta gol **urdi**, **o'tgan mavsumda** esa atigi ikkita **urgan**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **had** a holiday **this year**? — No, but I **had** two weeks off **last October**.
sentences.translation: **Bu yil** ta'tilga **chiqdingizmi**? — Yo'q, lekin **o'tgan oktabrda** ikki hafta dam **olganman**.

sentences.text: Sales **fell** **last quarter**, but they **have grown** nicely **this quarter**.
sentences.translation: Sotuvlar **o'tgan chorakda tushdi**, lekin **bu chorakda** yaxshigina **o'sdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **was** ill **last week**, but she **hasn't missed** a single day **this week**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **o'tgan hafta** kasal **edi**, lekin **bu hafta** birorta ham kunni **qoldirmadi**.

sentences.text: **Yesterday** I **worked** until nine, so **today** I**'ve taken** things easy.
sentences.translation: **Kecha** soat to'qqizgacha **ishladim**, shuning uchun **bugun** o'zimni **ayab turibman**.

sentences.text: The museum **had** a record number of visitors **last year**, and **this year** it**'s** already **beaten** that record.
sentences.translation: Muzeyga **o'tgan yili** rekord darajada ko'p odam **keldi**, **bu yil** esa bu rekord allaqachon **yangilandi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **sleep** well **last night**? You **haven't stopped** yawning **all morning**.
sentences.translation: **Kecha** yaxshi **uxladingmi**? **Ertalabdan beri** esnashdan **to'xtamayapsan**.

sentences.text: Oliver **has** already **spent** his salary **this month**, although he only **got** it **on Friday**.
sentences.translation: Oliver **bu oylik** maoshini allaqachon **sarflab bo'libdi**, holbuki uni faqat **juma kuni oldi**.

examples.title: **this morning**: is it still morning?
examples.description: this morning, this afternoon, this evening — zamon gapirilayotgan vaqtga bog'liq: davr hali davom etsa — Present Perfect, tugagan bo'lsa — Past Simple.

sentences.text: It's only half past nine, and I**'ve** already **had** three phone calls **this morning**.
sentences.translation: Soat hali to'qqiz yarim, **bugun ertalab** esa allaqachon uchta qo'ng'iroq **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: It's four o'clock now — **did** you **remember** to call the bank **this morning**?
sentences.translation: Hozir soat to'rt — **bugun ertalab** bankka qo'ng'iroq qilishni **esladingmi**?

sentences.text: By lunchtime Emma felt better, although she **was** sick **this morning**.
sentences.translation: Tushlikka kelib Emma o'zini yaxshi his qildi, holbuki **bugun ertalab** **qusgan edi**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **seen** the boss **this morning**? I need her signature before twelve.
sentences.translation: **Bugun ertalab** boshliqni **ko'rdingizmi**? Soat o'n ikkigacha uning imzosi kerak.

sentences.text: I **saw** the boss **this morning**, but she **left** for the airport after lunch.
sentences.translation: Boshliqni **bugun ertalab ko'rdim**, lekin u tushlikdan keyin aeroportga **jo'nab ketdi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, Grandma **has** already **taken** her tablets **today**.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, buvim **bugungi** dorilarini allaqachon **ichib bo'ldilar**.

sentences.text: Poor Jasur **hasn't eaten** anything **all day**, and it's already dark.
sentences.translation: Bechora Jasur **kun bo'yi** hech narsa **yemadi**, havo esa allaqachon qorong'i.

sentences.text: **This afternoon** we **had** a long meeting, and now I'm exhausted.
sentences.translation: **Bugun tushdan keyin** uzoq majlis **bo'ldi**, endi holdan toydim.

sentences.text: How many times **have** you **checked** your phone **this evening**? It must be twenty!
sentences.translation: **Bugun kechqurun** telefoningizni necha marta **tekshirdingiz**? Yigirma martadan kam emas!

sentences.text: In the evening Bekzod finally **replied** to the message I **sent** him **this morning**.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun Bekzod nihoyat men unga **bugun ertalab yuborgan** xabarga **javob berdi**.

examples.title: Up to now: **recently**, **so far**, **ever**, **yet**
examples.description: Hozirgacha cho'zilgan noaniq davr — recently, lately, so far, ever, yet, in the last ... — bilan Present Perfect. Aniq vaqt (a month ago, just now) — Past Simple.

sentences.text: **Have** you **been** to any good concerts **recently**?
sentences.translation: **So'nggi paytlarda** biror yaxshi konsertga **bordingizmi**?

sentences.text: Sales of electric cars **have increased** sharply **lately**.
sentences.translation: **Keyingi paytlarda** elektromobillar savdosi keskin **oshdi**.

sentences.text: **So far** we**'ve raised** two thousand pounds for the children's hospital.
sentences.translation: **Hozircha** bolalar shifoxonasi uchun ikki ming funt **yig'dik**.

sentences.text: This is the most delicious samsa I**'ve ever eaten**!
sentences.translation: Bu men **hayotimda yegan** eng mazali somsa!

sentences.text: The new manager **hasn't made** any decisions **yet**, so everyone is waiting.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer **hali** hech qanday qaror **qabul qilmadi**, shuning uchun hamma kutyapti.

sentences.text: I **saw** Nilufar **just now** — she's in the library.
sentences.translation: Nilufarni **hozirgina ko'rdim** — u kutubxonada.

sentences.text: Oliver **has just left** — you can still catch him at the bus stop.
sentences.translation: Oliver **hozirgina ketdi** — uni bekatda hali ushlab qolishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: **Has** anyone **complained** about the noise **since** the new bar **opened**?
sentences.translation: Yangi bar **ochilganidan beri** kimdir shovqindan **shikoyat qildimi**?

sentences.text: We **haven't heard** from the bank **yet**, although I **applied** for the loan a month **ago**.
sentences.translation: Bir oy **oldin** kreditga **ariza bergan bo'lsam ham**, bankdan **hali javob yo'q**.

sentences.text: Our town **has changed** a lot **in the last ten years** — there are three new schools now.
sentences.translation: **So'nggi o'n yil ichida** shahrimiz juda **o'zgardi** — endi uchta yangi maktab bor.

examples.title: **When did** ...? Closed periods: **lived** there **for** ...
examples.description: When ...? savoli va when I was ... kabi tugagan davr — Past Simple. for o'zi zamonni hal qilmaydi: holat davom etsa — Present Perfect, tugagan bo'lsa — Past Simple.

sentences.text: **When did** you **learn** to swim? — When I **was** about seven.
sentences.translation: Suzishni **qachon o'rgangansiz**? — Taxminan yetti **yoshimda**.

sentences.text: My father **lived** in Moscow **for five years** when he **was** young.
sentences.translation: Otam yoshligida Moskvada **besh yil yashagan**.

sentences.text: My aunt **has lived** in Samarkand **for five years** and doesn't want to move.
sentences.translation: Xolam **besh yildan beri** Samarqandda **yashaydi** va ko'chishni istamaydi.

sentences.text: **When did** the trouble **begin**? — Right after we **changed** the software.
sentences.translation: Muammo **qachon boshlandi**? — Dasturni **almashtirganimizdan** keyinoq.

sentences.text: **When** I **was** a student, I **worked** in a café at weekends.
sentences.translation: **Talabalik paytimda** dam olish kunlari kafeda **ishlaganman**.

sentences.text: James **played** rugby **for ten years**, but he **stopped** after a knee injury.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **o'n yil** regbi **o'ynadi**, lekin tizza jarohatidan keyin **to'xtatdi**.

sentences.text: Kate **has sung** in the church choir **since** she **was** twelve.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'n ikki **yoshidan beri** cherkov xorida **kuylaydi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you ever **meet** your great-grandmother? — Yes, she **died** when I **was** six.
sentences.translation: Katta buvingizni hech **ko'rganmisiz**? — Ha, men olti **yoshligimda** vafot **etgan**.

sentences.text: What time **did** the match **finish** last night? I **fell** asleep before the end.
sentences.translation: Kecha o'yin soat nechada **tugadi**? Oxirigacha **uxlab qolibman**.

sentences.text: During the pandemic, many people **worked** from home **for months** and **discovered** they liked it.
sentences.translation: Pandemiya paytida ko'p odamlar **oylab** uydan **ishladi** va bu ularga yoqishini **anglab yetdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a check-up at the clinic
examples.description: Shifokor va bemor suhbati: this week, since Tuesday, so far, yet — Present Perfect; last week, yesterday, on Sunday — Past Simple.

sentences.text: — Good morning. So, how **have** you **been feeling** **this week**?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli tong. Xo'sh, **bu hafta** o'zingizni qanday **his qildingiz**?

sentences.text: — Better, thanks. I **haven't had** a temperature **since Tuesday**.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshiroq, rahmat. **Seshanbadan beri** isitmam **chiqmadi**.

sentences.text: — Good. **Did** you **take** the antibiotics I gave you **last week**?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. **O'tgan hafta** bergan antibiotiklarimni **ichdingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **finished** the course **on Sunday**, just as you said.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **yakshanba kuni** kursni **tugatdim**, siz aytgandek.

sentences.text: — And **have** you **been** back to work **yet**?
sentences.translation: — Ishga **qaytdingizmi** hali?

sentences.text: — Not yet. I **went** to the office for an hour **yesterday**, but I felt tired.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. **Kecha** ofisga bir soatga **bordim**, lekin charchadim.

sentences.text: — That's normal. **Have** you **slept** well **over the last few nights**?
sentences.translation: — Bu tabiiy. **Oxirgi bir necha kecha** yaxshi **uxladingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Much better. **Last night** I **slept** for nine hours without waking.
sentences.translation: — Ancha yaxshi. **Kecha** to'qqiz soat uyg'onmasdan **uxladim**.

sentences.text: — Excellent. You**'ve made** a good recovery **so far**.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. **Hozircha** yaxshi **tuzalib kelyapsiz**.

sentences.text: — Thank you, doctor. I **haven't felt** this good **for weeks**!
sentences.translation: — Rahmat, doktor. **Haftalardan beri** o'zimni bunchalik yaxshi **his qilmagandim**!

examples.title: Mixed: finished time or up to now?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: vaqt so'zi va vaziyatga qarab Present Perfect yoki Past Simple — iqtisod, texnologiya, sport va sayohatdan.

sentences.text: Unemployment **rose** **in 2020**, but it **has fallen** steadily **since then**.
sentences.translation: Ishsizlik **2020-yilda oshdi**, lekin **o'shandan beri** barqaror **kamayib kelmoqda**.

sentences.text: I**'ve** already **used** half my mobile data **this month**, so I need to be careful.
sentences.translation: **Bu oy** mobil internetimning yarmini allaqachon **ishlatib bo'ldim**, ehtiyot bo'lishim kerak.

sentences.text: Where **were** you **on Saturday night**? I **called** you three times.
sentences.translation: **Shanba kuni kechasi** qayerda **eding**? Senga uch marta **qo'ng'iroq qildim**.

sentences.text: Emma **has worked** for three different companies **since** she **graduated**.
sentences.translation: Emma o'qishni **bitirganidan beri** uchta turli kompaniyada **ishladi**.

sentences.text: The ancient city of Khiva **attracted** thousands of traders **in the Middle Ages**.
sentences.translation: Qadimiy Xiva **o'rta asrlarda** minglab savdogarlarni **o'ziga jalb qilgan**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **checked** the weather forecast **today**? There might be a storm.
sentences.translation: **Bugun** ob-havo ma'lumotini **ko'rdingizmi**? Bo'ron bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Aziz **got** his first smartphone **when he was twelve** and **has replaced** it five times **since then**.
sentences.translation: Aziz birinchi smartfonini **o'n ikki yoshida oldi** va **o'shandan beri** uni besh marta **almashtirdi**.

sentences.text: Two days **ago** the minister **promised** new roads, but nothing **has happened** **so far**.
sentences.translation: Ikki kun **oldin** vazir yangi yo'llar **va'da qildi**, lekin **hozircha** hech narsa **o'zgarmadi**.

sentences.text: How many cities **have** you **visited** in Britain **so far**, and which **did** you **like** best?
sentences.translation: Britaniyada **hozirgacha** nechta shaharga **bordingiz** va qaysi biri sizga ko'proq **yoqdi**?

sentences.text: **Last month** I **ran** five kilometres for the first time, and **this month** I**'ve done** it three times.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan oy** ilk bor besh kilometr **yugurdim**, **bu oy** esa buni uch marta **uddaladim**.
